items.name: Bastard Sword
items.description: This broad-bladed sword, sometimes called the hand-and-a-half sword, has a longer grip so it can be held in one hand or used with two hands to provide extra piercing or slashing power.

items.name: Longbow
items.description: This 5-foot-tall bow, usually made of a single piece of elm, hickory, or yew, has a powerful draw and is excellent at propelling arrows with great force and at an extreme distance. You must use two hands to fire a longbow, and it can't be used while mounted.

items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.description: This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

generalAbilities.name: Convergent Link
generalAbilities.description:
Creatures with this ability can communicate with each other by manifesting an aura of wispy Utopian runes.

This has the effects of Telepathy with a range of 300 feet, but requires line of sight.

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Disrupted Link
defensiveAbilities.description: While a convergent soldier is Confused, Fascinated, or Frightened, they loses their convergent link and convergent tactics abilities.

offensiveAbilities.name: Convergent Tactics
offensiveAbilities.description: The convergent soldier's attacks deal an extra 4d8 damage to creatures within reach of one of their allies with convergent tactics.

offensiveAbilities.name: Force Communication
offensiveAbilities.description:
Utopian runes burst from the convergent soldier.

Any creature Stupefied by the Convergence Lattice who is within 100 feet of the convergent soldier and can see the runes must attempt a DC 34 Will Saving Throw save.

Failure For 1 round, the creature is Off-Guard to creatures with the convergent link ability and counts as an ally with convergent tactics for the purposes of activating the convergent tactics ability.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is also Slowed 1 for 1 round due to the information overload.
